## `@mark1russell7/lag/async-context`

```ts
import {
  ANONYMOUS_CALLBACK, type AddCallbackHookFn, CALLBACK_SOURCE_KINDS, type CallbackHookDeps,
  type CallbackHookLike, type CallbackSourceKind, LONG_CALLBACK_THRESHOLD_MS, type LongCallback,
  LongCallbackMonitor, type LongCallbackOptions, type OtelActiveSpanApiLike, activeSpanName,
  callbackSourceKind, createInstrumentedLongCallbacks, setupLongCallbacks,
} from "@mark1russell7/lag/async-context";
```

```ts
const ANONYMOUS_CALLBACK = "(anonymous)";

type AddCallbackHookFn = (hook: CallbackHookLike) => () => void;

const CALLBACK_SOURCE_KINDS: readonly ["timer", "promise", "event", "await", "observer", "stream", "lock", "frame", "other"];

type CallbackHookDeps = {
    addCallbackHook: AddCallbackHookFn;
};

type CallbackHookLike = {
    before?(callback: Function, source: string): void;
    after?(callback: Function, source: string): void;
};

type CallbackSourceKind = typeof CALLBACK_SOURCE_KINDS[number];

const LONG_CALLBACK_THRESHOLD_MS = 50;

type LongCallback = {
    readonly name: string;
    readonly source: string;
    readonly sourceKind: CallbackSourceKind;
    readonly durationMs: number;
    readonly startTime: number;
    readonly operation: string | undefined;
};

class LongCallbackMonitor {
    constructor(addCallbackHook: AddCallbackHookFn, report: (callback: LongCallback) => void, clock: Clock, logger: Logger, options?: LongCallbackOptions);
    get running(): boolean;
    stop(): void;
}

type LongCallbackOptions = {
    thresholdMs?: number;
    operation?: () => string | undefined;
};

type OtelActiveSpanApiLike = {
    trace: {
        getActiveSpan(): object | undefined;
    };
};

function activeSpanName(api: OtelActiveSpanApiLike): () => string | undefined;

function callbackSourceKind(source: string): CallbackSourceKind;

function createInstrumentedLongCallbacks(deps: CoreDeps & CallbackHookDeps & Partial<EventDeps> & Partial<SpanDeps> & Partial<AbsoluteClockDeps> & Partial<PerformanceDeps>, options?: LongCallbackOptions): MonitorHandle<LongCallbackMonitor>;

function setupLongCallbacks(monitors: Pick<AllMonitorHandles, "add">, addCallbackHook: AddCallbackHookFn, options?: LongCallbackOptions): MonitorHandle<LongCallbackMonitor>;
```
